name: print-social-fifty-poster-experiments-wall
title: Wall of fifty geometric poster experiments in primary colours
whatItIs: A black slide with a ten-by-five grid of small poster designs: red, blue, yellow, black and cream, each using a word and simple geometry (circles, stairs, waves, dots, lines, flowers, fish) with type distorted to match. 'Thanks for watching!' ends the slide.
whatItMeans: Playful and disciplined; a shared palette of primaries and a one-word-one-shape rule make fifty ideas feel like one family.
techniques: Pair each poster with one word and one visual idea (word-image mapping).
Use a strict palette of red, blue, yellow, black and cream.
Bend, crop and repeat type to illustrate its meaning.
Show many posters in a grid to prove range.

vocabulary.definition: Making the layout depict the word it shows.
Red, yellow and blue with black and cream.
A set of designs made under shared constraints.
Showing many works together at small size.
